title: 姊姊的粉紅單車
subject: a fifteen-year-old boy who inherits his big sister's pink bicycle with a white basket and a bell shaped like a strawberry when she leaves for university, gets laughed at by the whole school bike shed, and decides to ride it like it is a hot rod
caption: Mandarin rockabilly, 1950s Sun Records style. Hollow-body electric guitar with twangy Travis-picked licks and slapback echo, slapped upright bass clicking on every beat, snare-and-brush drum kit in a fast shuffle, pounding honky-tonk piano. Vintage mix with slapback reverb and a narrow stereo field. Male baritone, swaggering with hiccup accents, melody clearly sung. 168 BPM, E major. Cocky, bouncy and funny. No distorted guitars, no modern pop drums, no autotune, no synths, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - twangy guitar lick and slap bass]

[Verse 1]
姊姊去台北 讀大學
留下一台 粉紅單車
白色的籃子 草莓的鈴
停在我家 樓梯口

[Pre-Chorus]
我的舊車 鍊子斷了
只好牽它 去上學

[Chorus]
粉紅單車 叮叮叮
全校都在 看著我
頭髮梳高 腳踩快一點
草莓鈴聲 我最大聲

[Verse 2]
車棚裡面 一陣狂笑
說我騎著 女生的車
籃子裡 放顆籃球
從他們面前 甩尾過去

[Pre-Chorus]
放學後 隔壁班女生
問我能不能 載一段

[Chorus]
粉紅單車 叮叮叮
後座多了 一個人
頭髮梳高 腳踩慢一點
草莓鈴聲 換她來按

[Outro - guitar and piano tag]
姊姊打電話 問車還好嗎
